question: List the display names of users who posted at least one question in 2011 that received more than 5 favorites, and who also earned a badge in the same year, but only if their reputation is below the average reputation across all users.

prediction.sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_055 FROM users AS u WHERE u.XCL_053 < (SELECT AVG(XCL_053) FROM users) AND u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT p.XCL_033 FROM posts AS p WHERE p.XCL_027 = 1 AND STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2011' AND p.XCL_039 > 5) AND u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT b.XCL_002 FROM badges AS b WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2011')

semantic_memory.interpretation_policy: Assignments are conditional on the proposed role vocabulary; feasibility is not independent validation of business labels. Use original historical SQL and physical observations to compare competing interpretations.

eligibility.predicate: posts.XCL_027 = 1 AND STRFTIME('%Y', posts.XCL_029) = '2011' AND posts.XCL_039 > 5

arguments.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_055
FROM users u
WHERE u.XCL_053 < (SELECT AVG(XCL_053) FROM users)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
      AND p.XCL_027 = 1
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2011'
      AND p.XCL_039 > 5
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM badges b
    WHERE b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2011'
  )
